Title: A new set of Azure SDKs is now available in preview

Body.Content:
A new set of Azure SDKs is now available in preview. This first release will include SDKs for four Azure Services:

  • Azure Event Hub

  • Azure CosmosDB

  • Azure Storage

  • Azure Key Vault

and will be available in four different languages:

  • C# (.NET)

  • JavaScript

  • Java

  • Python

These libraries provide access to new service features and are the first step towards applying a new set of standards across the Azure SDKs that will make the libraries easier to learn and integrate into your software.

Learn more about this release on our blog post.

Learn more
